I am a Machine Learning Engineer at Apple, where I lead semantic search for iCloud Mail Intelligence, focusing on query understanding, retrieval, and ranking. I completed my Master’s in Computer Science at the Georgia Institute of Technology, specializing in Machine Learning.

I am interested in understanding and improving large language models, efficient machine learning, and building intelligent systems that work in the real world. My research has explored attention mechanisms in LLMs, explainable AI, and robotics.

Previously, I was a Machine Learning Engineer Intern at Apple. Before Georgia Tech, I worked as a Senior Software Development Engineer at BrowserStack and as a Software Engineer Intern at Swift Robotics, building autonomous disinfection robots.

If you would like to chat about research, engineering, or anything else, feel free to drop me an email.
